role_attribute_desc_atk.ch: 角色的攻击，影响角色在战斗中造成的伤害。
role_attribute_desc_atk.en: Affects how much damage your character deals during combat.

role_attribute_desc_basBlade.ch:
刀法资质，需要达到要求的值才可学习对应的刀法技能，并且可以提升化解敌人刀法技能的概率。

刀法资质可以通过使用刀灵果提升，刀灵果可在刀法宗门中的聚宝仙楼中兑换获得。
role_attribute_desc_basBlade.en:
Increase your Blade stat to the required value to learn the corresponding Blade skill and increase your chance to neutralize your enemies' Blade skills.

The Blade stat can be increased by using Blade Fruit, which is redeemed in the Treasure Pavilion of Blade Sects.

可以通过击败大地图中出现的血傀获得风水通论，使用通论后可提升此资质。
role_attribute_desc_basGeo.en:
Increase your Feng Shui stat to the required value to learn the corresponding Feng Shui skill.

Defeat Blood Puppets on the world map to obtain Feng Shui Textbooks, which can be used to increase your Feng Shui stat.

role_attribute_desc_basHerb.ch:
药材资质，需要达到要求的值才可学习对应的药谱。

可以通过击败大地图中出现的药灵获得药材通论，使用通论后可提升此资质。
role_attribute_desc_basHerb.en:
Increase your Herb stat to the required value to learn the corresponding Prescription.

Defeat Mushroom Men on the world map to obtain Herb Textbooks, which can be used to increase your Herb stat.

role_attribute_desc_basMine.ch: 影响角色在进行挖矿时，发现高品质矿材的概率。
role_attribute_desc_basMine.en: Affects your character's chance of getting high-rarity Ores when mining.

role_attribute_desc_basPalm.ch:
掌法资质，需要达到要求的值才可学习对应的掌法技能，并且可以提升化解敌人掌法技能的概率。

掌法资质可以通过使用掌灵果提升，掌灵果可在掌法宗门中的聚宝仙楼中兑换获得。
role_attribute_desc_basPalm.en:
Increase your Palm stat to the required value to learn the corresponding Palm skill and increase your chance to neutralize your enemies' Palm skills.

The Palm stat can be increased by using Palm Fruit, which is redeemed in the Treasure Pavilion of Palm Sects.

role_attribute_desc_basPil.ch:
炼丹资质，需要达到要求的值才可学习对应的丹方以及使用对应的丹炉，炼丹资质越高，炼丹的难度越低，且丹药的品质越好。

可以通过击败大地图中出现的丹魔获得炼丹通论，使用通论后可提升此资质。
role_attribute_desc_basPil.en:
Increase your Alchemy stat to the required value to learn the corresponding Elixir Recipe and use the corresponding Furnace. The higher your Alchemy stat, the easier it is for you to concoct better Elixirs.

Defeat Alchemists on the world map to obtain Alchemy Textbooks, which can be used to increase your Alchemy stat.

role_attribute_desc_basSym.ch: 影响角色在进行画符时，获得高品质符篆的概率。
role_attribute_desc_basSym.en: Affects your character's chance of getting high-rarity Charms when performing Talismans.

role_attribute_desc_basThunder.ch:
雷灵根，需要达到要求的值才可学习对应的雷属性技能，并且可以提升化解敌人雷属性技能的概率。

雷灵根可以通过使用雷灵果提升，雷灵果可在雷法宗门中的聚宝仙楼中兑换获得。
role_attribute_desc_basThunder.en:

role_attribute_desc_basWood.en:

role_attribute_desc_beauty.en: Charm influences the overall perception NPCs have of you, shaping their attitudes and behaviors towards you

role_attribute_desc_crit.ch: 影响角色在战斗中造成暴击的概率。
role_attribute_desc_crit.en: Affects your character's chance of landing a critical strike during combat.

role_attribute_desc_critV.ch: 影响角色在战斗中造成的暴击伤害倍数。
role_attribute_desc_critV.en: Affects how much critical damage your character deals during combat.

role_attribute_desc_def.ch: 角色的防御，降低角色在战斗中受到的伤害。
role_attribute_desc_def.en: Affects how much damage your character takes during combat.

role_attribute_desc_dp.ch:
角色在战斗中释放领域技能时，需要消耗道力值。
道力值每个月会自动少量恢复。
role_attribute_desc_dp.en:
Casting Field Skills during combat consumes Tao Power.
Tao Power recovers automatically by a small amount every month.

role_attribute_desc_energy.ch: 角色在进行一些行为时（如战斗），需要消耗精力，精力不足则无法进行。
role_attribute_desc_energy.en: Your character consumes Stamina when taking certain actions (e.g., combat). Without enough Stamina, the actions won't be taken.

role_attribute_desc_fsp.ch: 影响角色在大地图中移动的效率，脚力越高，移动时所需的时间越少。
role_attribute_desc_fsp.en: Affects how quickly your character moves on the world map. The higher the Travel Speed, the less time needed to reach the destination.

role_attribute_desc_guard.ch: 降低角色在战斗中受到暴击的概率。
role_attribute_desc_guard.en: Affects your character's chance of receiving a critical strike during combat.

role_attribute_desc_guardV.ch: 降低角色在战斗中受到的暴击伤害倍数。
role_attribute_desc_guardV.en: Affects how much critical damage your character takes during combat.

role_attribute_desc_health.ch: 健康过低时，会持续减少体力，当健康过低时，会获得负面气运。
role_attribute_desc_health.en: When Health is low, your character will lose Vitality over time and have a chance to receive negative Destinies.

role_attribute_desc_hp.ch: 体力是角色的生命值，在战斗中体力为0时，则会死亡。
role_attribute_desc_hp.en: Vitality is the equivalent of your character's HP. Your character will die during battle if Vitality drops to 0.

role_attribute_desc_life.ch: 寿命是生存的基础条件，当寿命用尽时，角色死亡且无法复活。
role_attribute_desc_life.en: Lifespan determines how long your character can live. When Lifespan reaches its limit, your character will die and can't revive.

role_attribute_desc_luck.ch: 幸运影响角色在各种行动中的随机结果。
role_attribute_desc_luck.en: Luck affects the results of your character's various actions.

role_attribute_desc_mfr.ch: 降低角色在战斗中受到的属性伤害。
role_attribute_desc_mfr.en: Affects how much Spiritual damage your character takes during combat.

role_attribute_desc_mood.ch: 心情影响角色的状态，当心情低落时，会有概率获得负面气运。使用兴趣类道具可以恢复心情。
role_attribute_desc_mood.en: Mood affects your character's status. When Mood is low, your character will have a chance to receive negative Destinies. Use Interest items to recover Mood.

role_attribute_desc_mp.ch: 角色在战斗中施放技能时，需要消耗灵力值。
role_attribute_desc_mp.en: Casting skills during combat consumes Energy.

role_attribute_desc_msp.ch: 角色在战斗中的移动速度。
role_attribute_desc_msp.en: Affects your character's movement speed during combat.

role_attribute_desc_pfr.ch: 降低角色在战斗中受到的功法伤害。
role_attribute_desc_pfr.en: Affects how much Martial damage your character takes during combat.

role_attribute_desc_reputation.en: Reputation influences the overall perception NPCs have of you, shaping their attitudes and behaviors towards you

role_attribute_desc_soulPoint.ch: 法宝需要足够的魂力，才能注入器灵。
role_attribute_desc_soulPoint.en: Artifact needs enough Spirit Power to infuse Artifact Spirit.

role_attribute_desc_sp.ch: 角色在战斗中使用道具时，需要消耗念力值。
role_attribute_desc_sp.en: Using items during combat consumes Focus.

role_attribute_desc_standDown.ch: 影响魔道势力对角色的态度。
role_attribute_desc_standDown.en: This influences how the Demonic Path perceives and interacts with you

role_attribute_desc_standUp.ch: 影响正道势力对角色的态度。
role_attribute_desc_standUp.en: This influences how the Righteous Path perceives and interacts with you

role_attribute_desc_talent.ch: 悟性影响角色在修炼技能时的消耗及效率。
role_attribute_desc_talent.en: Insight determines the cost and efficiency when your character upgrade skills.

role_character_desc1.ch: 为人大公无私，对朋友与宗门格外关注。
role_character_desc1.en: Selfless and caring, especially towards friends and sect.

role_character_desc11.ch: 重视独立，不愿合群，重视自我利益。
role_character_desc11.en: Values independence, unwilling to conform and prioritizes self-interest.

role_character_desc12.ch: 爱护家庭，对父母子女，兄弟姐妹，配偶特别重视。
role_character_desc12.en: Cares for family, especially parents, children, siblings, and spouse.

role_character_desc13.en: Values reputation and leans towards the Righteous Path.

role_character_desc14.ch: 重视权力，对自我，宗门比较关注，偏向魔道。
role_character_desc14.en: Values power, prioritizes self and sect, leans towards the Demonic Path.

role_character_desc15.ch: 睚眦必报，重视自已，仇恨敌人。
role_character_desc15.en: Seeks revenge, focuses on self and harbors hatred towards enemies.

role_character_desc16.ch: 为人任性不羁，在兴趣上会花更多时间。
role_character_desc16.en: Willful and unrestrained, spends more time on personal interests.

role_character_desc17.ch: 天生情种，永远在追求爱情的路上。
role_character_desc17.en: Naturally inclined towards love and constantly pursues it.

role_character_desc18.en: Values inheritance and respects teachers and teachings.

role_character_desc19.en: Loyal and unwavering in spousal love.

role_character_desc2.ch: 为人正直，对朋友与宗门比较关注，对仇人分外憎恨。
role_character_desc2.en: Honest and caring towards friends and sects, with a strong hatred towards enemies.

role_character_desc3.ch: 为人仁善，对其它人都比较友好。
role_character_desc3.en: Kind and benevolent, friendly towards others.

role_character_desc4.ch: 为人中庸，对所有人都是一样的。
role_character_desc4.en: Moderate and fair, treats everyone the same.

role_character_desc5.ch: 为人狂妄邪门，行事风格诡异。

role_character_desc6.ch: 以利已为最大出发点，对仇人不愿宽容。
role_character_desc6.en: Self-interest is the top priority, unwilling to forgive enemies.

role_character_desc7.ch: 邪恶，唯已所欲，从来不管其它人的感受。
role_character_desc7.en: Evil, only pursuing own desires, disregards others' feelings.

role_character_desc8.ch: 重视天伦之乐，爱父母、子女、师父、徒弟。
role_character_desc8.en: Values family bonds, loves parents, children, master, and disciples.

role_character_desc9.ch: 重视义气，为朋友两肋插刀，维护宗门。
role_character_desc9.en: Values loyalty and friendship, willing to sacrifice for friends and Defenseend the sect.

role_grade_Desc12.ch: 必要材料：三花丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc12.en: Necessary materials: Three Flower Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc13.ch: 必要材料：云中丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc13.en: Necessary materials: Cloud Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc14.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵珠之一。灵珠的纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用玄微丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc14.en: Necessary materials: Any 1 of the 6 Qi Orbs. The higher the Qi Orb's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Subtlety Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc15.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵珠之三。灵珠的纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用聚灵丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc15.en: Necessary materials: Any 3 of the 6 Qi Orbs. The higher the Qi Orbs' Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Soul Gathering Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc16.ch: 必要材料：所有六道灵珠。灵珠的纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用万河丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc16.en: Necessary materials: All 6 Qi Orbs. The higher the Qi Orbs' Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Thousand River Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc19.ch: 必要材料：化灵丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc19.en: Necessary materials: Spirit Transformation Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc22.en: Necessary materials: Nascent Soul Elixir (Mortal). The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc23.ch: 必要材料：地道之气。气息纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用破茧丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc23.en: Necessary materials: Earth Aura. The higher its Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Nascent Soul Elixirs (Earth) to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc24.ch: 必要材料：天道之气。气息纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用六窍丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc24.en: Necessary materials: Heaven Aura. The higher its Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Nascent Soul Elixirs (Heaven) to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc27.en: Necessary materials: Soul Reconstruction Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc30.ch: 必要材料：悟道丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc30.en: Necessary materials: Enlightenment Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc31.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵斗气之一。灵斗气纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用天化丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc31.en: Necessary materials: Any 1 of the 6 Condensed Qi. The higher the Condensed Qi's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Realm Enlightenment Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc32.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵斗气之三。灵斗气纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用天化丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc32.en: Necessary materials: Any 3 of the 6 Condensed Qi. The higher the Condensed Qi's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Realm Enlightenment Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc33.ch: 必要材料：所有六道灵斗气。灵斗气纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用天化丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc33.en: Necessary materials: All 6 Condensed Qi. The higher the Condensed Qi's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Realm Enlightenment Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc36.ch: 必要材料：羽化丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc36.en: Necessary materials: Reborn Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc39.ch: 必要材料：登仙丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc39.en: Necessary materials: Transcendent Elixir (Yellow). The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc4.ch: 必要材料：筑基丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功率越高。
role_grade_Desc4.en: Necessary materials: Foundation Elixir (Mortal). The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.

role_grade_Desc40.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵斗珠之一。灵斗珠纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用鸿蒙丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc40.en: Necessary materials: Any 1 of the 6 Condensed Qi Orbs. The higher the Condensed Qi Orb's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Path Transcendent Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc41.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵斗珠之三。灵斗珠纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用鸿蒙丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc41.en: Necessary materials: Any 3 of the 6 Condensed Qi Orbs. The higher the Condensed Qi Orbs' Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Path Transcendent Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc42.ch: 必要材料：所有六道灵斗珠。灵斗珠纯度越高，突破时的成功概率越高。可辅用鸿蒙丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc42.en: Necessary materials: All 6 Condensed Qi Orbs. The higher the Condensed Qi Orbs' Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Three Path Transcendent Elixirs to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc5.ch: 必要材料：任意六道灵气之三。灵气的纯度越高，突破时的成功率越高。可辅用地坤丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc5.en: Necessary materials: Any 3 of the 6 Qi. The higher the Qi's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Foundation Elixirs (Earth) to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc6.ch: 必要材料：所有六道灵气。灵气的纯度越高，突破时的成功率越高。可辅用天乾丹增加成功概率。
role_grade_Desc6.en: Necessary materials: All 6 Qi. The higher the Qi's Purity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough. You can also use Foundation Elixirs (Heaven) to increase your success rate.

role_grade_Desc9.ch: 必要材料：化晶丹。丹药品质越高，突破时的成功概率越高。
role_grade_Desc9.en: Necessary materials: Qi Condensation Elixir. The higher the Elixir's rarity, the higher the success rate of your Breakthrough.
